lines.l: I was wandering in the rain
Swift and sudden fall from rain
Cremlin' shadow, the hood, all in me
Starless doom, I won't let me be
On and on and on, it came
It's the rain, but you's letting me
How does it feel, how does it feel
How does it feel, how does it feel
When you're alone and you're cold inside
Take my name, but you just let me be
Then a bigger boy called my name
On and on and on, it came in the rain
In my name, it was living me
I got you, I got you
When you're alone and you're cold inside
How does it feel, how does it feel?
When you're alone in the cold inside
